items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I really don't know whether it got to Sy.

ctx.x: Sy was presumably yelling to Tommy about that, I should imagine?

I really don't know whether it got to Sy. I can't think of why it wouldn't have, but I didn't say anything like that. I'm not the kind of a person that makes snotty remarks about people. I don't do that. But Tommy was upset about that and when I heard that he was upset, I said well, that's life. If he's upset, let him be upset.
I might as well ask it on camera, we were going over the list of the people you had worked for before Raeburn, cleaning up that area of history, and commenting on such.
